mingPalace.title: The Ming palace is the foundation, the three directions are the application
mingPalace.body: Master Ni always stressed that reading a chart begins with the Ming palace. The star in the Ming palace sets a person's basic pattern and innate character, while the three directions (Wealth, Career, Travel) determine where that person can put their talents to use. Only the four palaces read together form a complete picture of a life.

oppositePalace.title: Borrowing stars from the opposite palace cannot be ignored
oppositePalace.body: Master Ni's distinctive approach was to value the opposite palace. Whenever a palace has no major star, its reading must borrow the stars of the palace opposite; the Ming palace faces the Migration palace and the two shape each other — a key point many beginners overlook.

siHua.title: The four transformations are the hand of destiny
siHua.body: The stars are only the foundation; the four transformations (Hua Lu, Hua Quan, Hua Ke, Hua Ji) decide whether fortune runs well or badly. The same star with Hua Lu or with Hua Ji can lead to completely different life paths. Master Ni repeated it: without the four transformations, only half the chart is read.

decadeCycle.title: Ten-year cycles give fortune its rhythm
decadeCycle.body: Master Ni divided a life into twelve decade cycles of ten years each. In his view, a person's circumstances differ completely from one cycle palace to the next. Only by knowing which cycle you are in — and which stars occupy that palace — can you truly grasp your present fortune.

threeRealms.title: Heaven · Earth · Human
threeRealms.introLine1: Ni Hai-Xia's core view of destiny: fate is never the whole of a life.
threeRealms.introLine2: He divided the forces that shape a life into three equally important dimensions.

heaven.label: Innate destiny
heaven.desc: What Zi Wei Dou Shu reveals is the innate pattern of a person's chart — the star layout, the five-element bureau and the ruler of the Life palace, all fixed by the moment of birth. That is only one third of destiny: the base coat of a life, not the whole picture.

earth.label: Geographic environment
earth.desc: The geography you live in — your city, country and feng shui, down to family background and social structure — forms the second dimension of destiny. With the same chart, being born in different places can mean a world of difference in what comes your way.

human.label: Human mind and will
human.desc: A person's will, mindset, choices and actions are the most active force for changing destiny. Master Ni stressed that reading a chart is for becoming a better person, not for sitting and waiting on fate. Improving yourself is the strongest way to break through.

threeRealms.quote: 「Fate is not the whole of life — add geography and human intention, and then it is.」

master.heading: Master Ni Hai-Xia
master.tagline1: One of the most influential masters of Chinese medicine and the metaphysical arts in the contemporary Chinese-speaking world
master.tagline2: Founder of the Han Tang College of Chinese Medicine in the US · His two teaching systems, “Ren Ji” and “Tian Ji”, carry his legacy

source.label: Biography:
source.body: Mr. Ni Hai-Xia (1954–2012) was born in Taiwan. In his early years he studied under several renowned physicians and specialised in the classical formula school (the lineage of the Treatise on Cold Damage). In mid-life he moved to the United States to practise medicine and founded the **Han Tang College of Chinese Medicine**, teaching Chinese medicine and traditional divination systematically for more than twenty years. He died of liver cancer in Taiwan on 31 January 2012, at the age of 58.

teaching.label: Teaching system:
teaching.body: Master Ni organised a lifetime of study into two public teaching series. **“Ren Ji”** (Records of the Human) covers the Great Compendium of Acupuncture and Moxibustion, the Shennong Bencao Jing, the Huangdi Neijing, the Treatise on Cold Damage and the Essentials of the Golden Cabinet — the “record of the human”, which lays out the complete path of Chinese medicine study. **“Tian Ji”** (Records of Heaven) covers Zi Wei Dou Shu and the I Ching — the “record of heaven”, the systematised fruit of divination research. Together they form the most complete legacy Master Ni left to later generations.

stance.label: Position on Zi Wei:
stance.body: In Zi Wei Dou Shu, Master Ni stands clearly with the **Southern San He school**, holding that “the Life palace is the foundation, the three directions and four corners are the application, and the Four Transformations are the outline”. In his Tian Ji course he said plainly: “_Flying stars (the Four Transformations) flying back and forth is too complicated — I don't do that; after all, the great way is simple._” That position sets him clearly apart from the elaborate Flying Star school.

scholarship.label: Scholarly attitude:
scholarship.body: Master Ni opposed rote memorisation of mnemonic verses, insisting that “understanding the principle beats recitation” and “checkable logic beats mystical obscurity”. That attitude carried Zi Wei Dou Shu out of a closed system of secret transmission from master to disciple, into a modern body of knowledge that is systematic, verifiable and learnable.

influence.label: Contemporary influence:
influence.body: Master Ni's lecture videos circulate widely on Bilibili, YouTube and other major platforms, and a new generation of astrology and Chinese medicine enthusiasts treats them as required introductory material. He was not only a transmitter of Zi Wei Dou Shu but one of the key figures who brought traditional astrology and Chinese medicine into the modern knowledge system.

disclaimer.body: Every reading on this platform is compiled from Master Ni's public Tian Ji lecture notes, the Ming-dynasty edition of the Complete Book of Zi Wei Dou Shu, and classical texts of the traditional San He school. It is offered for cultural and personal-growth reference only. Master Ni himself has no commercial connection with this platform.

starBriefs.ziwei: Zi Wei is the emperor star, ruling dignity. In the Life palace it brings leadership presence and suits large organisations and senior roles.
starBriefs.tianji: Tian Ji is the star of intelligence and adaptability. In the Life palace it brings a quick, strategic mind suited to advisory and planning work.
starBriefs.taiyang: Tai Yang is the noble star of public life. In the Life palace it brings openness and suits public office and reputation-building roles.
starBriefs.wuqu: Wu Qu is the wealth star of resolve and decisiveness. In the Life palace it brings strong money management and suits industry and finance.
starBriefs.tiantong: Tian Tong is the star of blessing and ease. In the Life palace it brings a gentle temperament and an easygoing fortune.
starBriefs.lianzhen: Lian Zhen is the secondary peach-blossom star, skilled in both letters and arms. In the Life palace it brings versatility and strong feelings.
starBriefs.tianfu: Tian Fu is the southern emperor and keeper of wealth. In the Life palace it brings integrity and an ability to hold on to assets.
starBriefs.taiyin: Tai Yin is the moon star of wealth and property. In the Life palace it brings refined sensitivity and is especially favourable for women.
starBriefs.tanlang: Tan Lang is the star of desire and sociability. In the Life palace it brings many talents and a wide social circle.
starBriefs.jumen: Ju Men is the star of debate and speech. In the Life palace it brings strong argumentative skill and suits law and teaching.
starBriefs.tianxiang: Tian Xiang is the supporting seal star. In the Life palace it brings honesty and suits administration and legal work.
starBriefs.tianliang: Tian Liang is the elder star of protection that turns misfortune into fortune. In the Life palace it brings compassion and suits law and medicine.
starBriefs.qisha: Qi Sha is the general star of solitude and bold decisions. In the Life palace it brings firmness and suits the military, police or entrepreneurship.
starBriefs.pojun: Po Jun is the star of breaking and rebuilding. In the Life palace it brings pioneering change and suits specialised technical work.
